winnica.name: Winnica Academic Chaplaincy
winnica.description: Project and implementation of a modern, responsive website for the Winnica Academic Chaplaincy in Gdańsk-Wrzeszcz. The website was designed for students and young adults, providing easy access to information about meetings, events, initiatives, and the community's activities.

moonight.description: A planner for movie nights. Designed for watching movies with friends. You create a group, share a list of movies, and vote together on the movies you want to watch.

parafia.name: Parish of the Holy Cross in Gdańsk-Wrzeszcz
parafia.description: Project and implementation of a website for the Parish of the Holy Cross in Gdańsk-Wrzeszcz. The aim of the project was to create a clear and functional website, making it easier for parishioners to access the most important information, pastoral announcements, Holy Mass schedule, and parish news.

superquiz.description: Project and development of a mobile application with a quiz game inspired by the popular TV quiz show 'One for Ten'. The app allows you to test your knowledge in various fields, compete with opponents, and develop quick thinking skills. The gameplay mirrors the key mechanics of the TV show, offering dynamic fun, a scoring system, and player elimination.

superquizdesktop.description: Project and development of a desktop quiz application inspired by the popular TV quiz show 'One for Ten'. The game allows you to test your knowledge in various fields, compete with computer-controlled opponents, and improve your quick thinking skills. The application offers various gameplay modes, a scoring system, player elimination mechanics, and progress statistics.

walker.description: A mobile application for planning walks, tracking routes, and monitoring activity, supporting the development of healthy habits and an active lifestyle.
